title: Clinical Coverage Policy — One Coverage-Paid Mobility Equipment Chair at a Time
content:
# One Coverage-Paid Chair at a Time — Mobility Equipment

**Policy.** Coverage pays for one wheelchair at a time. A coverage-billed Mobility Equipment order is not opened while another coverage-billed chair of the patient is rental active or suspended, or patient owned with fewer than the class's reasonable useful lifetime months elapsed since its delivery date, unless it is a replacement under the Mobility Equipment replacement rules. A manual chair as a backup for a power chair user, or a second chair for another home, is never billed to coverage; the patient may buy it self-pay. Rental months billed for a duplicate chair are denied with the denial reason same or similar and never charged to the patient.

The useful lifetime read here is the reasonable useful lifetime of the class of the existing chair, in months; the manual-or-power type is the type of the class.

## When an existing coverage-billed chair stands in the way

| Existing coverage-billed chair of the patient | A new coverage-billed order |
|---|---|
| rental active | not opened, unless it is a replacement under the replacement rules |
| suspended | not opened, unless it is a replacement under the replacement rules |
| patient owned, fewer months than the useful lifetime elapsed since its delivery date | not opened, unless it is a replacement under the replacement rules |

## Chairs never billed to coverage

- a manual chair as a backup for a power chair user;
- a second chair for another home.

Either may be bought by the patient self-pay.

## Duplicate rental months

Rental months billed for a duplicate chair are denied as same or similar. Such a denied month is never charged to the patient.

## Hypothetical illustration

A patient owns a coverage-billed manual chair delivered 30 months ago, and the class's useful lifetime is 60 months (hypothetical figures for the illustration). Fewer months than the useful lifetime have elapsed, so a second coverage-billed chair order is not opened unless it is a replacement under the replacement rules; a second chair for another home could be bought self-pay.
